source: 9. How do Contextual Retrieval and Late Chunking try to preserve document-level context, and how are they different? [Advanced] Both techniques address the same failure: a chunk may be locally understandable to a human who saw the whole document, yet ambiguous when embedded alone. Anthropic’s Contextual Retrieval generates a short chunk-specific description from the full document and prepends that context before building semantic and lexical indexes. Late Chunking takes a different route: a long-context embedding model first computes token representations while the tokens can attend to the larger document, and only then are token representations pooled into chunk vectors. The former changes the text being indexed and can work with ordinary downstream embedding/BM25 pipelines; the latter changes where chunking occurs inside the embedding computation and requires a model that supports the method. Neither is a universal replacement for normal chunking. Both add cost or model assumptions and should be evaluated on the actual corpus. Anthropic’s reported gains are results from its own experiments, not a general guarantee. [5][6]
zh: 9. 上下文检索和后期分块如何尝试保留文档级上下文，它们有何不同？ [高级] 这两种技术都解决了同样的问题：对于看到整个文档的人来说，一个块可能是本地可以理解的，但单独嵌入时却是模糊的。 Anthropic 的上下文检索从完整文档中生成一个简短的特定于块的描述，并在构建语义和词汇索引之前添加该上下文。后期分块采用不同的路线：长上下文嵌入模型首先计算令牌表示，而令牌可以处理更大的文档，然后才将令牌表示汇集到块向量中。前者改变了被索引的文本，可以与普通的下游嵌入/BM25管道一起工作；后者改变了嵌入计算中分块发生的位置，并且需要支持该方法的模型。两者都不是正常分块的通用替代品。两者都会增加成本或模型假设，并且应该在实际语料库上进行评估。 Anthropic 报告的收益是其自己实验的结果，而不是一般保证。 [5][6]
